ZMT Loader - automatic modpack collision solver for Motor Town.

Needs: Plugin Loader and DataTable Framework.

Install: in Steam, right-click Motor Town > Manage > Browse local files, then drag the MotorTown folder from this
zip into that window and let it merge.

Settings: MotorTown\Binaries\Win64\plugins\zmt_loader.ini (created on first launch).
Source and releases: https://github.com/qxZap/ZMTLoader
